gaps.statement: ¬ (have x1 : List (ℕ × ℕ) := [((0 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ))]; have x2 : (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x2 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => Decidable.decide (∃ (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), (↑x3, ↑x4) ∈ x1 ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true); have x3 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ := fun (x3 x4 x5 x6 : ℕ) => ((15 : ℕ) * Min.min x3 x4 + Max.max x3 x4) * (225 : ℕ) + ((15 : ℕ) * Min.min x5 x6 + Max.max x5 x6); have x4 : Equiv.Perm (Fin (14 : ℕ)) → Fin (15 : ℕ) → ℕ := fun (x4 : Equiv.Perm (Fin (14 : ℕ))) (x5 : Fin (15 : ℕ)) => if ↑x5 < (14 : ℕ) then ↑(x4 (Fin.ofNat (14 : ℕ) ↑x5)) else (14 : ℕ); ∃ (x5 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x6 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x7 : Fin (15 : ℕ)) (x8 : Fin (15 : ℕ)) (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp) (x10 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp) (x11 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   x5 < x6 ∧     x7 < x8 ∧       (x9 = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x9 = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧         (x10 = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x10 = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧           (∀ (x12 : Equiv.Perm (Fin (14 : ℕ))), (∀ (x13 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x2 (x13 ∘ ⇑x12) = x2 x13) → x3 ↑x5 ↑x6 ↑x7 ↑x8 ≤ x3 (↑(x12 x5)) (↑(x12 x6)) (x4 x12 x7) (x4 x12 x8)) ∧             PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x11 ∧               x11.size ≤ (24 : ℕ) ∧                 ∀ (x12 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool),                   have x13 : List Bool := List.ofFn x12 ++ [x9.eval [x12 x5, x12 x6]];                   x11.eval (x13 ++ [x10.eval [x13.getD (↑x7) Bool.false, x13.getD (↑x8) Bool.false]]) = x2 x12)
